# Water System Overview

The garden uses a gravity-fed system: a 2000 liter tank feeds a central manifold, which splits into four zone valves. Each zone serves a row of plots.

The irrigation method for each zone follows the ruling in [Drip vs Sprinkler Irrigation](/knowledge-base/decisions-drip-vs-sprinkler.md). Operating procedures live in the [Irrigation Schedule Runbook](/knowledge-base/runbooks-irrigation-schedule.md).

Tank sizing was based on the [municipal rainfall tables](https://example.org/rainfall-tables), an external reference.
